title: Meta Ads Manager
summary: Run Facebook/Meta ads from the command line: reports, duplicate, edit budgets, pause/resume, and build new campaigns + ad sets from a JSON spec. Every write is a reviewable plan, and new objects are always created PAUSED.
how_to_use: Ask "how are my ads doing?", "duplicate the winning ad set", "raise the budget to $40/day".
requires: Your own Meta Marketing API access token and ad account ID (SETUP.md).
